The 1 oz Silver Bullet Elemental Box from Bullion Trading LLC offers a special product to gun enthusiasts, collectors, and investors. Each box includes 20 exquisite bullets, each crafted from .999 pure silver and modeled after the .45 ACP round, a well-known and widely used cartridge in the United States.
This unique Elemental Box offers a wonderful investment opportunity for those seeking to diversify their portfolio with unique silver items. Each bullet in the box has a diameter of 0.50 inches and a length of 1.25 inches, adding a significant and striking addition to any collection or investment.
Besides the 1 oz Silver Bullet Elemental Box, Bullion Trading LLC also offers individual 2 oz and 5 oz silver bullets. The 2 oz silver bullet is designed based on the .308 caliber round, while the 5 oz silver bullet is inspired by the 12 gauge shotgun shell. Each of these products is composed of .999 pure silver
You can purchase the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set, as well as the individual 1 oz and 5 oz versions, from Bullion Trading LLC by visiting the following links:
2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/2-oz-silver-bullet/
1 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/1-oz-silver-bullet/
5 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/5-oz-silver-bullet/
For any queries or concerns about the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set or the individual silver bullets offered by Bullion Trading LLC, you can reach their customer service team via email at
[email protected]
, or by calling 646-362-3536.
